title: Molecular docking and molecular dynamics of hypoxia-inducible factor (HIF-1alpha): towards potential inhibitors.
authors: Reda, Dina; Elfiky, Abdo A; Elnagdy, M; Khalil, Magdy M
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选HIF-1alpha小分子抑制剂，虽用物理模拟方法，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: HIF-1alpha is a primary regulator in the adaptation of cancer cells to hypoxia. The aim was to find out new inhibitors of the HIF-1alpha. A molecular dynamic (MD) simulation performed on HIF-1alpha showed stable dynamic features. Virtual screening of 217 anticancer drugs was performed along with a positive control (2-Methoxyestradiolm, 2-ME2) on an optimized HIF-1alpha and dynamically simulated structure. Docking results produced two compounds namely pycnidione and nilotinib of high binding affinity -9.34 kcal/mol and -9.04 kcal/mol respectively, whereas 2-ME2 displayed a relatively lower affinity (-6.68 kcal/mol). For the three complexes, MD of 200 ns simulation was run. Data analysis showed that the three medications behaved similarly in the MD simulation. Nilotinib had a lower RMSD and higher SASA than the other complexes. In addition, the Nilotinib-HIF-1alpha combination had a lower RMSF value, a flatter Rg, and a number of hydrogen bonds similar to other complexes. MM-GBSA analysis revealed that nilotinib, pycnidione and 2-ME2 compounds had free binding energy of -23.77 +/- 5.29, -21.85 +/- 4.24 and -7.53 +/- 6.62 kcal/mol respectively. Nilotinib and pycnidione bind competitively to HIF-1alpha, with nilotinib showing consistent molecular-dynamic properties. They relatively pass the blood-brain barrier, non-carcinogenic, and have IV-category acute oral toxicity. They have low CYP inhibitory characteristics. Further investigations are therefore warranted to elucidate their implications in hypoxia pathways, cell proliferation, apoptosis, survival, and metastatic potential.
abstract_zh: HIF-1α是癌细胞适应低氧环境的主要调控因子。本研究旨在发现HIF-1α的新型抑制剂。对HIF-1α进行的分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟显示其具有稳定的动态特征。以阳性对照（2-甲氧基雌二醇，2-ME2）对217种抗癌药物进行虚拟筛选，靶标为优化后的HIF-1α及其动态模拟结构。对接结果产生了两种高结合亲和力的化合物，即pycnidione和nilotinib，其结合亲和力分别为-9.34 kcal/mol和-9.04 kcal/mol，而2-ME2显示出相对较低的亲和力（-6.68 kcal/mol）。对这三个复合物进行了200 ns的MD模拟。数据分析显示，三种药物在MD模拟中表现相似。Nilotinib的RMSD较低，SASA高于其他复合物。此外，Nilotinib-HIF-1α复合物的RMSF值较低，Rg更平坦，且氢键数量与其他复合物相似。MM-GBSA分析显示，nilotinib、pycnidione和2-ME2化合物的自由结合能分别为-23.77 ± 5.29、-21.85 ± 4.24和-7.53 ± 6.62 kcal/mol。Nilotinib和pycnidione竞争性结合HIF-1α，其中nilotinib表现出一致的分子动力学特性。它们相对能穿过血脑屏障，无致癌性，并具有IV类急性口服毒性。它们具有较低的CYP抑制特性。因此，有必要进行进一步研究，以阐明它们在低氧通路、细胞增殖、凋亡、存活和转移潜能中的作用。
